questions.questionText: Under AS 1, what are the three fundamental accounting assumptions that do not require specific disclosure if followed?

options.text: Prudence, Materiality, and Substance over Form.
Historical Cost, Dual Aspect, and Entity Concept.

questions.explanation: According to AS 1 (Disclosure of Accounting Policies), Going Concern, Consistency, and Accrual are fundamental accounting assumptions. If followed, specific disclosure is not required.

questions.questionText: Which of the following items is classified as a Cash Flow from Operating Activities under AS 3?

options.text: Cash receipts from sale of goods and rendering of services.
Cash proceeds from issuance of equity shares.
Cash payments to acquire plant, property, and equipment.
Redemption of debentures at a premium.

questions.explanation: Operating cash flows are primarily derived from the principal revenue-producing activities of the enterprise (AS 3).

questions.questionText: Based on the scenario above, what is the maximum number of directors that Apex Dynamics Limited can appoint without passing a special resolution under Section 149(1) of the Companies Act, 2013?

caseStudy.title: Apex Dynamics Board Expansion Scenario
caseStudy.scenarioText: Apex Dynamics Limited is an unlisted public company having a paid-up share capital of ₹50 Crores and an annual turnover of ₹350 Crores. The board currently consists of 12 directors. The management is planning to induct 4 additional industry experts to lead global expansion and ESG compliance initiatives.

questions.explanation: Under Section 149(1) of the Companies Act, 2013, a company may appoint a maximum of 15 directors. Appointing more than 15 directors requires a Special Resolution passed by shareholders.

questions.questionText: What is the entry to record the settlement of trade payables at a cash discount?

options.text: Debit Trade Payables, Credit Bank, Credit Discount Received.
Debit Bank, Debit Discount Allowed, Credit Trade Payables.

questions.explanation: When trade payables are settled with a discount, Trade Payables A/c is debited (full amount), Bank A/c is credited (net paid), and Discount Received A/c is credited.
